liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Listener considers this the nicest version of the song they have heard [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-05-01.sbd.miller.95683.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 126 min; rated 4.62/5 by 37 [1]
- **gd70-05-01.sbd.clugston.5465.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 13 songs; 89 min; rated 4.22/5 by 32 [3]. Said about its sound: Audio quality and performance match the following day's recording; The recording features clear audio quality; Bobby and Jerry exchange licks during the performance [5][7][8][16]
- **gd1970-05-01.sbd.gans-miller.85322.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 13 songs; 89 min; rated 4.3/5 by 10 [2]
- **gd1970-05-01.sbd.unknown.93.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 3 songs; 12 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Small New York school venue; band transitioned from acoustic to electric [10]
- Acoustic set included members of the New Riders; Garcia played pedal steel [3]
- May 1970 followed gigs at Fillmore West and Family Dog in San Francisco [21]
- Performance sounds identical to the version on the Philzone Fallout release [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-05-01.sbd.miller.95683.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Source 1: SBD -> Master Reel -> CD Source 2: SBD ->Master Reel -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD Source 3: SBD -> Master Reel -> Reel-> Dat -> Sonic Solutions ->… [1]. Also: Sources 2 and 3 provided by David Gans; pitch correction by Joe B. Jones [1]
- **gd70-05-01.sbd.clugston.5465.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Listener searched for this show for over a decade, questioning its authenticity; Reels found under stage at Merrimac CC confirmed the May 1 date; Master Soundboard Reel transferred to DAT, then Sonic Solutions, CDR, SHN by Scott Clugston [3][14][15]
- **gd1970-05-01.sbd.gans-miller.85322.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by David Gans and Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD [2]
- **gd1970-05-01.sbd.unknown.93.sbeok.shnf**: source: soundboard [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by lostlivedead.blogspot.com: [The Grateful Dead in Upstate and Central New York 1969-79 ('Til Your Night Job Pays)](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2020/05/the-grateful-dead-in-upstate-and.html) [23]
